description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for a WebAudioPlayer component within the Rialto client, including a factory class for creating WebAudioPlayer instances, and the WebAudioPlayer class itself which manages audio playback, IPC communication, and client notifications.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WebAudioPlayer, implementing IWebAudioPlayerFactory.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing IWebAudioPlayer, IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient, and IControlClient, managing audio playback, IPC, and client notifications.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing WebAudioPlayer with client, mime type, priority, config, IPC factory, and client controller.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a change in WebAudioPlayer state.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a change in application state.
